original_content_full: The paper "Integration of Image Processing Techniques into the Unity Game Engine" by Leon Masopust, Sebastian Pasewaldt, Jürgen Döllner, and Matthias Trapp was accepted for publication and presentation at the 1. International Conference o Image Processing and Vision Engineering 2021. The conference is held virtually from April 28th to April 30th.
